chunks: And it is narrated from ʿAbdullāh ibn Muskān, from Abū Hilāl al-Rāzī, who said:

I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: A man appointed another man as an agent for the divorce of his wife when she menstruates and then becomes pure, and then the man went away, but afterward a new view occurred to him, so he made witnesses that he had annulled what he had ordered him to do and that he had reconsidered in that matter.
He said: "Then let him inform his wife and let him inform the agent."

key_terms.أَبْطَلَ: he nullified; he revoked the prior instruction
key_terms.أَهْلَهُ: his wife; his household here referring to the spouse
key_terms.الْوَكِيلَ: the agent; the person authorized to act on another's behalf
key_terms.بِطَلَاقِ: for divorce; concerning the execution of divorce
key_terms.حَاضَتْ: she menstruated; the onset of the menstrual period
key_terms.طَهُرَتْ: she became pure; the end of menstruation
key_terms.وَكَّلَ: appointed as an agent; delegated authority for an act

ai.seo_question: What should a man do if he revokes his authorization for an agent to divorce his wife?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding agency in divorce and the revocation of that authorization. If a man retracts the instruction he had given to his agent, he must communicate that revocation to his wife and to the appointed agent so that the matter is made known properly.
